visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in an indoor market-style restaurant. A woman with her hair tied back, wearing a brown and green fleece jacket over a black turtleneck, sits at a white table. In front of her are three bowls of food and a tray. She gestures with her hands open and smiles warmly at the camera. (2) Detailed close-ups of the food follow: a bowl of clear soup with wontons and green onions, a large white steamed bun on a pale green plate, and a bowl of dry noodles topped with minced meat and scallions. A yellow cup with a blue logo sits on the table. (3) The woman is seen using black chopsticks to lift noodles and eat them with an enthusiastic expression, later giving a thumbs-up. (4) A man with short hair and glasses, wearing a brown and green utility jacket, joins the scene. He is shown eating a wonton and taking a large bite of the steamed bun while looking at the camera. (5) The scene shifts to a modern, brightly lit indoor shopping mall or cinema lobby. The man holds the camera in a selfie-style handheld shot while walking alongside the woman. They are both smiling and talking. (6) They stop in front of a large blue movie poster titled 'Mickey 17,' where the woman points at the characters. (7) The couple continues walking through various sections of the mall, passing a toy sale area with red bins and a Dyson retail counter with white and black displays. (8) The final visual is a simple 2D animation of two small characters in green and white clothing skating across a solid beige background.

(2) A male voice joins, speaking in a slightly lower pitch but with equal enthusiasm. There is a metallic 'clink' of chopsticks against a bowl. (3) Soft slurping and chewing sounds occur as the speakers describe the food. The BGM maintains a steady, rhythmic pace. (4) The acoustic environment shifts to a wider, more reverberant space, suggesting a transition from a small eatery to a large hall. Distant, muffled crowd noise is audible. (5) Frequent laughter and fast-paced conversational overlap between the two voices dominate. (6) A short, bright digital bell chime plays briefly during a transition, and the BGM continues until a fade-out at the very end.
